run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum sum by recursively breaking a number into n/2, n/3, and n/4 parts
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter set of 10 numeric inputs
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the dynamic programming approach with a memoized recursive solution
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the DP recurrence relation comparing i versus dp[i/2]+dp[i/3]+dp[i/4]
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses dynamic programming to find the maximum sum from breaking n into thirds
